title: Dear tomorrow
alt: Seven long Chinese sentences and a title are written in white chalk on a sunlit green classroom blackboard.
description: Long, coherent Chinese handwriting rendered as chalk, with natural surface texture, warm classroom light and small hand-drawn illustrations.
prompt:
A cinematic photograph of a large dark green classroom chalkboard covered with beautiful, highly legible handwritten Chinese. Fine chalk dust, a little colored drawing of a sun and paper airplane, a small white flower and an old wooden chair at the lower edge. Warm afternoon light, realistic board texture and ample line spacing.
The complete text on the page reads: “给明天的自己” “今天没有完成的事，可以明天再继续。” “不要因为走得慢，就忘了看看沿途的风景。” “认真吃饭，好好睡觉，也记得和朋友见面。” “有时勇敢并不是向前冲，而是愿意重新开始。” “你已经走过了很长的路，请对自己温柔一点。” “把今天的最后一点光，留给新的愿望。” “明天见，未来的你。”. Render only this quoted copy, with natural line breaks and clear, correct lettering. No extra words.
